job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
This is: the job

We're looking for a Senior Project Manager to step into a highly visible transformation program and lead the delivery of two critical streams of work that will help solve long-standing business challenges.

This role requires an experienced delivery leader who can navigate complexity, build alignment across a large stakeholder group, and drive outcomes in an environment focused on execution rather than bureaucracy. You'll partner closely with senior leadership, act as a trusted second-in-command, and bring structure, accountability, and momentum to a program that will shape the organisation for years to come.

Based in Melbourne, this initial 6-month contract will suit someone who thrives in challenging environments, enjoys leading through ambiguity, and has the credibility to influence stakeholders at every level.

This is: what you'll do
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of key transformation initiatives
  • Drive program outcomes across a large and complex stakeholder landscape
  • Manage engagement and alignment across more than 80 stakeholders
  • Deliver strategic data-related initiatives focused on quality and consistency
  • Oversee the planning and execution of a new testing strategy and environment roadmap
  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership to remove roadblocks and accelerate delivery
  • Establish clear governance, accountability, and delivery discipline
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and competing priorities across multiple workstreams
  • Drive teams towards agreed outcomes while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships
  • Support long-term transformation objectives through practical and effective execution
This is: what you'll need
  • Extensive experience as a Senior Project Manager delivering complex enterprise programs
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across executive, operational, and delivery teams
  • Experience delivering data-related projects, including data quality and governance initiatives
  • Exposure to ERP environments and end-to-end enterprise platforms
  • Experience establishing or improving testing strategies and delivery frameworks
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence, challenge, and drive accountability
  • High levels of integrity, resilience, and commercial judgement
  • Ability to thrive in complex environments with significant organisational change

  • Lead a transformation program tackling long-standing business challenges

job.title: Salesforce Architect

outcomes.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer - Azure
job.description:
This is: the job

This is a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer - Azure to join a growing data and technology team delivering enterprise-scale analytics, AI, and data platform initiatives.

You'll play a key role in building modern data solutions that drive better business decisions, improve operational performance, and support innovation across the organisation. This is a hands-on senior role suited to someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges, shaping technical solutions, and working with modern cloud technologies—specifically PySpark and Azure Data Factory—in a highly visible environment.

This is: what you'll do

  • Core Pipeline & Data Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable enterprise data pipelines using PySpark, Python, SQL, and Azure Data Factory to drive batch and near real-time data solutions.

  • Platform Architecture: Design and optimise cloud-based data platforms across Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers aligned to enterprise standards.

  • Enterprise Integration: Ingest and integrate data across major business systems—including SAP, Salesforce, and Denodo—via APIs, ODBC/JDBC, and file-based transfers.

  • AI & Science Partnership: Partner closely with Data Scientists to operationalise machine learning models, feature engineering pipelines, and Generative AI use cases.

  • Quality & Best Practices: Drive automation, DataOps, CI/CD, data quality frameworks, and governance across the data landscape.

  • Production Support & Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis and resolve complex data, pipeline, and source-system integration issues within production environments.

This is: what you'll need

  • Experience: 5–7+ years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale data engineering and integration solutions.

  • Core Tech Stack: Strong, expert-level hands-on experience with PySpark and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

  • Programming & Querying: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.

  • Cloud & Platform Mastery: Proven experience building and supporting cloud-based data platforms (experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Delta Lake, or Azure Synapse is highly regarded).

  • Enterprise Integration: Demonstrated capability integrating complex enterprise platforms (SAP, Salesforce) using REST APIs and ODBC/JDBC patterns.

  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Solid understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and modern data engineering practices (CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Git, DataOps).

  • Stakeholder & Delivery: Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical requirements and business outcomes in an Agile environment.

This is: the perks

  • Join a business investing heavily in data, analytics, and AI capability.

  • Work on enterprise-scale platforms, high-impact transformation initiatives, and modern Azure environments.

  • High-impact role with strong visibility across the business and technical teams.

  • Opportunity to shape data platform capability, design reusable frameworks, and drive engineering standards.

job.title: SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead
job.description:
This is: the job

An opportunity exists for an experienced SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead to join a major SAP S/4HANA transformation program in Melbourne. This is a 12 month contract in a hybrid environment, suited to a hands-on leader who can shape reporting strategy while staying close to design, delivery and quality.

You will lead the reporting and analytics workstream across the SAP analytics landscape, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, embedded analytics and Fiori-based reporting. The role will translate business reporting needs into a clear, governed analytics architecture and ensure dashboards, reports, KPIs and data models are trusted from go-live.

This is a high-impact role working across data, functional, technical and business teams. You will partner with senior stakeholders, guide delivery resources, challenge legacy reporting habits and help build a reporting capability that supports better decisions across a complex enterprise environment.

This is: what you'll do
  • Lead the reporting and analytics workstream across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere and embedded analytics
  • Define the target-state analytics architecture, reporting strategy, standards and roadmap
  • Drive requirements workshops with business stakeholders and functional leads across statutory, operational, management and self-service reporting
  • Oversee the design and build of reports, dashboards, KPIs, semantic models, CDS views and analytical data model.
  • Manage reporting governance, including naming conventions, KPI definitions, version control, lineage and business glossary alignment
  • Drive report rationalisation by challenging legacy lift-and-shift requests and promoting standardisation
  • Collaborate with data migration, master data, security, integration and technical architecture teams to ensure reporting is secure, scalable and supportable
  • Manage reporting test strategy across SIT, UAT and reconciliation against source and legacy systems
  • Lead reporting developers, analysts and partner resources to deliver the reporting backlog
  • Support transition to operations, including hypercare, support processes, knowledge transfer and documentation
This is: what you'll need
  • Proven experience leading reporting or analytics workstreams on a full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Products and S/4HANA embedded analytics
  • Experience with CDS views, Fiori analytical apps, semantic models, dashboards and SAP reporting architecture
  • Solid understanding of SAP data models and reporting-relevant modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP or similar
  • Experience defining data governance standards, KPI definitions, reconciliation controls and reporting quality frameworks
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage senior business, technology and delivery stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to lead mixed teams of analysts, developers and implementation partner resources
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the confidence to balance standardisation against genuine business need
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to technical and executive audiences
  • A degree in business, technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Lead a critical analytics workstream on a major SAP S/4HANA transformation
  • Shape the reporting architecture, governance model and Day 1 decision-support capability
  • Work with senior stakeholders across data, technology, functional teams and business reporting ownership
